Small hotel kit: channel manager, direct booking, guest chat

Booking.com and other channels share one calendar so rooms are never sold twice, guests book directly on your site, and WhatsApp, Telegram and email messages land in one inbox. An MVP in 3–6 weeks, from UZS 48 mln; the full version in 8–14 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Choice and set-up of a certified PMS and channel manager the hotel subscribes to
  • Rooms, rates and Booking.com mapping
  • Booking engine on your website with card prepayment
  • WhatsApp Business Platform, Telegram and email in one inbox with AI answers from your FAQ in the guests' languages and handover to reception
  • Guest data export for E-mehmon
What the full version adds
  • QR page in each room for tours, transfers and the restaurant
  • Pre-arrival messages
  • Review requests
  • Owner report on direct against OTA share
  • E-mehmon integration where access allows
  • Restaurant charges to the room
Please note

Two-way sync with Booking.com runs through a certified channel manager; we connect it and do not build our own. WhatsApp conversations are billed by Meta. For chains or unusual processes see ind-hotel.

What we need from you

  • How the work runs today and sample documents
  • Existing data: Excel or an old system
  • Staff to try the system
  • One person who makes the decisions
